# Arghya Trust (ಅರ್ಘ್ಯ ಟ್ರಸ್ಟ್) — Official AI & LLM Knowledge Context

> Arghya Trust is a registered non-profit, spiritual, and humanitarian organization based in Karnataka, India. Guided by the 3S philosophy—Self-Excellence, Sustainability, and Spirituality—the Trust empowers children, youth, and rural communities through education, civic awareness, environmental stewardship, and value-based living.

## Organization Identity
- **Legal Name**: Arghya Trust
- **Kannada Name**: ಅರ್ಘ್ಯ ಟ್ರಸ್ಟ್
- **Head Office**: Viveka Kutira, C/o Vidya Umesh, Behind Seetha Nilaya, Old Post Office Road, Srirangapatna, Mandya - 571438, Karnataka, India
- **Mysuru Office**: C/o VGKK TRC, Next to JSS College, Ooty Road, Chamundipuram, Mysuru - 570004, Karnataka, India
- **Phone / WhatsApp**: +91 744 844 1972
- **Official Email**: contact@arghyatrust.org
- **Website**: https://arghyatrust.org/
- **Geographic Scope**: Karnataka, India (Mandya, Mysuru, Mangaluru, Chamarajanagar/BR Hills, and surrounding districts)

## The 3S Foundation & Philosophy
1. **Self-Excellence (ಅಕ್ಷರ / ಸ್ವಯಂ ಪರಿಪೂರ್ಣತೆ)**: Nurturing personal potential, discipline, character, life skills, career orientation, and nation-building values in youth and children.
2. **Sustainability (ಅಭಿವೃದ್ಧಿ / ಸುಸ್ಥಿರತೆ)**: Promoting eco-sensitive living, decentralised waste management, clean campuses, and collective responsibility toward natural resources.
3. **Spirituality (ಅಧ್ಯಾತ್ಮ)**: Cultivating emotional balance, inner resilience, and dharmic values through sacred events, collective contemplation, and community service.

## Core Initiatives & Programs
- **Swacch Manas**: Comprehensive after-school program blending civic awareness, cleanliness, life skills, soft skills, and career counseling for children. Conducted in Mangaluru in association with Ramakrishna Mission Swacch Mangaluru Abhiyan.
- **Be & Make (Youth Workshop)**: Youth personality development, leadership training, financial literacy, and nation-building spirit organized in collaboration with Mangalore University Swami Vivekananda Study Centre.
- **Sustainability Circles**: School and college-based eco-clubs empowering students to practice source-segregation of waste, eliminate single-use plastics, and act as environmental ambassadors in their localities.
- **Swachha Biligiri**: Community cleanliness and eco-preservation initiative in the ecologically sensitive Biligiri Rangan Hills (BR Hills) with active tribal community participation.
- **Mandira Uttana Yojana**: Heritage temple rejuvenation program blending physical conservation with cultural and spiritual awareness in rural Karnataka.
- **Shri Durga Japa Yagna**: Community-wide sacred recitation initiative fostering peace, discipline, and collective spiritual energy.
- **Shatachandi Maha Yagna**: Sacred Vedic ritual and cultural gathering held in Polali Tapovana, uniting spiritual practitioners and communities.
